diagnostics.ambiguity: Full Jacobian rank is local only and does not prove global uniqueness. In joint mode, d>0 fixes x direction, beacon 2 y>0 selects the planar reflection, and h>0 selects beacons above the fixed tag plane. These conventions select branches rather than supply new measurements.

experiment.coordinate_convention: Right-handed Cartesian frame in metres. The planar tag trajectory is z=0. For the informative map, beacon b0=(0,0,h), b1=(d,0,h), b2 has positive y, and all four beacons share height h>0. Beacon IDs are zero-based.
